note: FX1 (re/screens/input.md §1): DoKeyboard's F-keys and their gates from the starmap: F4 research (opening), F5 (research's closing, then design's opening), F8 (design's closing, trade's opening), F2 (trade's closing), F9 info, F10 messages from info, P refused on messages, F2 back, 2 (speed sound), M messages, M again (nothing), Esc out, F3 colony, F2 back, O options, F4 from options (research), F4 again (nothing), Esc (options at once), Esc (back to research). O, M and P are typed characters (SDL_TEXTINPUT).
